questions.question: I was an Indian freedom fighter and the first Prime Minister of India. People call me 'Chacha' because of my love for children. Who am I?
I discovered gravity when an apple fell from a tree. My laws of motion changed physics forever. Who am I?
I was the first person to step on the moon in 1969. My famous words were 'That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.' Who am I?
I am known as the 'Missile Man of India' and played a key role in India's missile and space programs. Who am I?
I was an Indian queen who fought against the British in 1857. I am known for my bravery and riding into battle with my child. Who am I?
I painted the famous Mona Lisa and was also an inventor and scientist. Who am I?
I was a scientist who developed the theory of relativity and the famous equation E=mc². Who am I?
I was the first President of the United States and played a major role in the American Revolution. Who am I?
I was an Egyptian queen known for my beauty and my relationship with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony. Who am I?
I was a great Indian mathematician who invented zero. Who am I?
I was the 16th President of the United States and played a key role in abolishing slavery. Who am I?
I was a famous Indian mathematician known for my extraordinary contributions to number theory. My birthday is celebrated as National Mathematics Day in India. Who am I?
I was a legendary warrior king and the founder of the Maratha Empire. I fought against the Mughal Empire. Who am I?
I was a famous physicist who formulated the laws of planetary motion. My discoveries helped shape modern astronomy. Who am I?
I was the first female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, known as the 'Iron Lady.' Who am I?

ExtraQuestion.question: I was an Indian freedom fighter known as the 'Father of the Nation' and led the Dandi March against British rule. Who am I?
I was the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean. My plane disappeared mysteriously during my final flight. Who am I?
I was a Greek philosopher and the teacher of Alexander the Great. My writings formed the foundation of Western philosophy. Who am I?
I was a famous artist who painted 'The Starry Night' but struggled with mental health issues. Who am I?
I was the first African American President of the United States, serving from 2009 to 2017. Who am I?
I was an Italian explorer who traveled to China and wrote about my journeys in 'The Travels of Marco Polo.' Who am I?
I was an Indian revolutionary known for my role in the Kakori Train Robbery and my bravery against British rule. Who am I?
I was the leader of the Soviet Union during World War II and played a major role in the Cold War. Who am I?
I am a famous fictional spy created by Ian Fleming. I work for MI6 and have a license to kill. Who am I?
I was a Greek warrior who built the Trojan Horse, leading to the fall of Troy. Who am I?
